profit_quality.assessment: 2025 turned profitable after a 2024 disposal and prior impairments, but distributable cash is much weaker than reported profit suggests. Operating cash flow was HKD 200.352m, while PPE purchases were HKD 208.710m; 2023 operating cash flow was only HKD 7.013m and 2024 was distorted by a disposed business.
adjustments: Started from reported 2025 parent net profit of HKD 120.355m.
Did not use 2024 and 2023 net profit median because both years contain large impairment/disposal distortions and do not represent the post-disposal business base.
Reduced pre-haircut distributable cash profit to HKD 60m to reflect maintenance capex, working-capital needs and customer/inventory risk.
Applied 0.50 profit haircut because free cash flow after PPE purchases was negative in 2025 and the post-restructuring track record is only one year.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2025 OCF HKD 200.352m, PPE purchases HKD 208.710m; 2024 OCF HKD 681.109m and PPE purchases HKD 400.063m; 2023 OCF HKD 7.013m and PPE purchases HKD 285.604m.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Recent profitability relies on post-disposal restructuring, lower depreciation and some other income; long-term cash conversion after maintenance capex is not yet proven.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Reported 2025 OCF/net profit ratio is above 1, but after PPE purchases free cash flow was negative.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Company disclosed capex of about HKD 200m for 2025, mainly additions to PPE for expansion and support of segments; no precise maintenance capex split was disclosed, so HKD 120m is retained as a conservative recurring estimate.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Receivables and inventories remain large relative to profit, with customer concentration and prior inventory provisions.
